Free AI course 1 of 5: Salesforce Trailhead 👀

No 47-tab rabbit hole today. This trail gives you a real starting point: AI basics, generative AI, language AI, data, responsible use and image generation. It has 8 steps and Salesforce estimates about 3h 15m.

My way to make it stick: do 2–3 lessons per sitting, explain one takeaway in your own words, then test it on a topic you actually care about. For the final mini project, make a study buddy that explains, gives an example and quizzes you—then check its answers.

Course: “Get Started with Artificial Intelligence” on Salesforce Trailhead
https://trailhead.salesforce.com/content/learn/trails/get-started-with-ai-data

Save this for your first session. What should course 2 cover: prompting, building or machine learning?
